abstract: OBJECTIVE: To report the case of a pregnant patient diagnosed with a primary retroperitoneal tumor and to conduct a review of the literature pertaining to the diagnosis, treatment and maternal-fetal prognosis of this disease condition during pregnancy. METHODS: A 19-year-old patient who presented with a retroperitoneal tumor identified on ultrasound. The results of the percutaneous biopsy showed a benign tumor. A healthy neonate was delivered by cesarean section. Surgical resection was performed four months later, and histopathology showed a mature cystic teratoma. A search was conduced in the Medline via PubMed, Lilacs, SciELO and ScienceDirect databases using the terms "pregnancy," "neoplasms," and "retroperitoneal neoplasms," including case reports and case series of retroperitoneal tumors during pregnancy. Diagnosis, treatment and maternal-fetal prognosis were identified. RESULTS: Overall, 1658 titles were identified. Of these, 34 case reports and 1 case series met the inclusion criteria. Of the cases, 62.9 % were benign. Diagnosis was made as an incidental finding in 63 % of cases, and 77 % of the masses were identified on ultrasound. Percutaneous biopsy was used in 8 % of cases, including the case reported here. Surgical treatment was used in 88 % of cases usually after delivery. Maternal mortality occurred in 8.5 % of cases. Fetal prognosis was good in 65 % of the pregnancies. CONCLUSIONS: Despite being frequently benign, retroperitoneal tumors during gestation have a reserved maternal and fetal prognosis in a substantial number of cases. There is a need to assess the risks and benefits of percutaneous biopsy.

目的：妊娠中に原発性後腹膜腫瘍と診断された妊婦の症例を報告するとともに、妊娠中のこの疾患の診断、治療、母体および胎児の予後に関する文献をレビューすること。
方法：19歳の患者が超音波検査で同定された後腹膜腫瘍を主訴に受診した。経皮的生検の結果、良性腫瘍であった。健康な新生児が帝王切開で出生した。4か月後に外科的切除が行われ、病理組織学的検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。PubMed経由のMedline、Lilacs、SciELO、ScienceDirectの各データベースで、「pregnancy」「neoplasms」「retroperitoneal neoplasms」の用語を用いて検索を行い、妊娠中の後腹膜腫瘍の症例報告および症例集積を含めた。診断、治療、母体および胎児の予後を検討した。
結果：全体で1,658件の文献が同定された。このうち、34件の症例報告と1件の症例集積が選択基準を満たした。症例の62.9%は良性であった。診断は63%の症例で偶発的に行われ、77%の腫瘤は超音波検査で同定された。経皮的生検は本症例を含む8%の症例で行われた。外科的治療は88%の症例で行われ、通常は出産後であった。母体死亡は8.5%の症例で発生した。胎児の予後は妊娠の65%で良好であった。
結論：妊娠中の後腹膜腫瘍は、しばしば良性であるにもかかわらず、多くの症例で母体および胎児の予後は慎重に考える必要がある。経皮的生検のリスクと利点を評価する必要がある。
